payload.summary: Clinical eval battery misses high-risk scenarios: no hepatic, older-adult, interaction or false-premise cases (audit F14 + F15)
payload.detail: Verified offline by topic count over src/lib/rag/rag-eval-cases.ts (101 cases): hepatic 0, older adult/elderly 0, drug interaction 0, unsafe/false premise 0, Mental Health Act 1, QTc 2, pregnancy 3, paediatric 2. Owner recommendation (2026-09-25): start with ~20 clinician-reviewed cases (3 pregnancy/breastfeeding, 3 renal/hepatic, 2 older adults, 2 QTc, 2 lithium/clozapine monitoring, 2 overdose, 2 interactions, 2 MHA, 2 false-premise where the right answer corrects the premise); engineering drafts expected key facts + source, owner reviews. Adding golden cases touches the eval harness (RAG-protected surface): flag before editing, and live canary dispatches need approval.
